meals.name: Kefir & Blueberry Smoothie + Boiled Eggs on Sourdough with Avocado
meals.image_prompt: overhead photo of two soft-boiled eggs halved on toasted sourdough with sliced avocado, beside a tall glass of purple kefir blueberry smoothie, natural morning light on a white marble counter
day_of_steps: 1. Place 2 eggs (Diego) / 2 eggs (Diana) in a small saucepan, cover with cold water, bring to boil, cook 7 min, drain and cool under cold water.
2. While eggs cook, pour 250 ml kefir into a blender, add 80 g blueberries and half a banana; blend 20 sec until smooth. Pour into a tall glass.
3. Toast 50 g sourdough (Diego) / 35 g sourdough (Diana) until golden.
4. Peel eggs and halve. Slice 40 g avocado (Diego) / 30 g avocado (Diana).
5. Arrange eggs and avocado on toast. Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of smoked paprika.
6. Serve smoothie alongside. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.image_prompt: overhead shot of a wide bowl with seasoned ground beef, red lentils, roasted red and yellow bell peppers, fluffy quinoa, a drizzle of olive oil and a splash of balsamic glaze, warm Mediterranean tones, natural light
prep_steps: Sunday: Roast bell peppers — see prep_batch_3.
Sunday: Cook canned lentils with garlic, cumin and tomato passata — see prep_batch_4.
day_of_steps: 1. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add 160 g lean ground beef (Diego) / 120 g (Diana); break apart and cook 5 min until browned. Season with 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp smoked paprika, salt and pepper.
3. Meanwhile, reheat 100 g cooked quinoa (Diego) / 75 g (Diana) in microwave 90 sec.
4. Reheat 80 g roasted peppers (Diego) / 60 g (Diana) and 80 g cooked lentils (Diego) / 60 g (Diana) together in microwave 90 sec.
5. Assemble bowl: quinoa base, then lentils, roasted peppers, then beef on top.
6. Drizzle 1 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp balsamic vinegar over bowl. Add ½ sliced orange as fruit alongside.
7. Serve with 500 ml water.

meals.name: Soy-Ginger Baked Salmon with Stir-Fried Broccoli & Spinach on Sourdough
meals.image_prompt: a dinner plate with a golden soy-ginger glazed salmon fillet alongside stir-fried broccoli florets and wilted spinach, a slice of toasted sourdough on the side, warm evening light, appetising
day_of_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 200°C. Mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp ginger powder, 1 tsp garlic powder, a squeeze of lime juice in a small bowl.
2. Place 160 g salmon fillet (Diego) / 130 g (Diana) on a lined baking tray. Spoon half the marinade over each fillet.
3. Bake salmon 15 min until flesh flakes easily.

4. Meanwhile, heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick pan. Add 120 g broccoli florets (Diego) / 90 g (Diana) and stir-fry 4 min. Add 50 g fresh spinach each, toss 1 min until wilted. Season with a pinch of chilli powder and salt.
5. Toast 40 g sourdough (Diego) / 30 g (Diana).
6. Plate salmon alongside vegetables and toast. Serve with 500 ml water.
